csv_project_name: AE for Range Tower Complex Building Repair 6131
csv_agency: State of Michigan Dept of Management & Budget
csv_scope_of_work: The Government requires comprehensive Architect-Engineer (A-E) design services for the holistic repair and renovation of the Range Tower Complex, Building 6131. Building 6131 is a 12,247 square-foot facility with a Plant Replacement Value (PRV) of approximately $15 million, located at the Grayling Air-to-Ground (ATG) Gunnery Range (10930 Steelgate Rd, Frederic, MI 49733). This facility is an integral component of the Alpena Combat Readiness Training Center (CRTC). The A-E shall provide all personnel, materials, equipment, and supervision necessary to design, prepare construction documents, estimate costs, and develop all deliverables required for this project.
